games.name: [MOON🌙] BladeBound [BETA💠]
games.desc:
⚔️ BladeBound 🔥 

🧊Cryokinesis UPDATE!


Battleground inspired by Demon Slayer Anime series

Step into the battleground and prove your strength in fast-paced sword combat!
No mercy. No limits. Just pure skill.

💥 Intense PvP battles
🌌 Stylish anime-inspired visuals
🎮 Smooth controls & epic duels




Much more content coming soon

Good luck in fights🛡

Controls:
----
[1-4] or [L1-L2-R1-R2] : Character Skills {some skills can be hold or have many variations}
[R] or [DPadR]:  Special Move
[W]: Sprint
[M1] or [O / B]: Base Punch
[M1] + (Timing): Sword Clash
[M1] x 4: Base Combo  
[M1] x 4 + [Space]: Uppercut
[M1] x 4 + (In Air): Downslam  
[F] or [□ / X] : Block
[F] + (Timing): Parry
[F] + (Timing + Close): Block Clash
[B]: Open Emote Wheel
[Q] or [△ / Y] : Dash
[G] or [DpadD]: Awakening
[DpadL]: Camera Lock

----



Expect many bugs since it's only early BETA

games.name: 💥 Bomb Tag Survival
games.desc:
👍 Like the game for more updates!

🏆 Bomb Tag Survival is a fun tag minigame. The objective is to pass the bomb and not blow up to stay alive the longest! Earn coins and compete with others on the leaderboards!

🎉 How to play:
- Pass the Bomb by touching someone.
- Avoid having the bomb when the timer runs out, or you'll be eliminated.
- Last one standing wins!
- Tip: The bomber runs faster than everyone else.

⚠️ Cosmetics such as different bombs do not give you an advantage.
⚠️ You do not gain wins in VIP servers.

✨ Join our group for an exclusive bomb cosmetic!
- https://www.roblox.com/groups/15187355
